items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel art game item sprite atlas on a truly transparent background. EXACTLY 3 isolated sprites in ONE horizontal row, centered in three equal square cells, generous transparent padding. Left: ornate antique golden key with heart-shaped bow. Center: black vinyl record with magenta center label and gold musical spark. Right: single crimson rose with green stem and two leaves. Gothic romantic Victorian castle adventure, crisp chunky 16-bit pixel art, dark plum outlines, gold and rose highlights, no lettering, no shadows outside objects, no frames, no extra objects. All items fully contained within their own third, consistent visual size. Landscape canvas.
